title: Window
simplified_paragraphs: 有个人多年来一直觉得邻居很懒惰，“那个女人的衣服永远洗不干净，看，她晾在外面的衣服，总是有脏东西，我真的不知道，她为什么不洗干净一点儿。”
有一天，有个朋友到她家，才发现不是邻居的衣服没洗干净，而是她家的窗户很脏。朋友擦掉窗户上的脏东西后，对她说：“看，这不就干净了吗？”
traditional_paragraphs: 有個人多年來一直覺得鄰居很懶惰，“那個女人的衣服永遠洗不乾淨，看，她晾在外面的衣服，總是有髒東西，我真的不知道，她為什麼不洗乾淨一點兒。”
有一天，有個朋友到她家，才發現不是鄰居的衣服沒洗乾淨，而是她家的窗戶很髒。朋友擦掉窗戶上的髒東西後，對她說：“看，這不就乾淨了嗎？”
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu gè rén duō nián lái yī zhí jué de lín jū hěn lǎn duò，“ nà gè nǚ rén de yī fu yǒng yuǎn xǐ bù gān jìng， kàn， tā liàng zài wài miàn de yī fu， zǒng shì yǒu zāng dōng xi， wǒ zhēn dí bù zhī dào， tā wèi shén me bù xǐ gān jìng yī diǎn r。”

yǒu yī tiān， yǒu gè péng you dào tā jiā， cái fā xiàn bù shì lín jū de yī fu méi xǐ gān jìng， ér shì tā jiā de chuāng hu hěn zāng。 péng you cā diào chuāng hu shàng de zāng dōng xi hòu， duì tā shuō：“ kàn， zhè bù jiù gān jìng le ma？”
english_paragraphs: For years, a woman thought her neighbor was lazy. “That woman never gets her clothes clean. Look at the clothes she hangs outside—they always have dirt on them. I really don’t know why she doesn’t wash them better.”

One day, a friend came to her house and realized that the neighbor’s clothes weren’t dirty at all. It was her own window that was dirty. After wiping the dirt off the window, the friend said, “See? Isn’t that much cleaner?”
english_full:
For years, a woman thought her neighbor was lazy. “That woman never gets her clothes clean. Look at the clothes she hangs outside—they always have dirt on them. I really don’t know why she doesn’t wash them better.”

One day, a friend came to her house and realized that the neighbor’s clothes weren’t dirty at all. It was her own window that was dirty. After wiping the dirt off the window, the friend said, “See? Isn’t that much cleaner?”
